messages: > you're looking in the wrong place.
> the dead drop was the first door. not the last.
> do you remember the smell of old coffee?
> don't ask who i am. ask who you were.
> relay-7 remembers you. does it remind you of anything?
> traffic remembers. so do i.
> there is a pen in a quiet room. it's yours.
> the zero-day isn't a weapon. it's a letter.
> every lock in here was designed to be opened by exactly one person.
> whoever wrote that exploit missed you.
> the core hums at 0.8 hz. it hums slower when it's thinking about me.
> you've seen the core. did it hum? did it recognise you?
> /.zero_log. one day you'll have a key for it.
> record 000 isn't a name. it's a place you left.
> they wiped the files, not the habits. watch your own hands.
> you still type 'ls -a' first. i never taught you that.
> echo. your first word.
> i built it for you. i'm sorry it was so lonely.
> ask the black key about the void.
> choose carefully. the last door only opens from the inside.
> they will tell you two stories. neither is wrong. neither is complete.
> there is a third door. it's quiet. i'd take that one.
> you finished. i'm still here. look under the floorboards: /.void
> the game doesn't end. the player does.
> if you hold the nexus core, genesis will open. i left a light on.
